response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong open-source contributions and some high-scale systems experience (low-latency DLang services handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby). However, he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience (only ~7 months at National Instruments plus a thesis project), and his career centers on web/product development in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than cloud compute platform engineering. He also lacks demonstrated formal technical leadership of teams or platform-level strategy ownership, making him a poor fit for this specific role despite his general seniority.
strengths: Real large-scale, low-latency distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/second)
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, courses, and open-source projects
Broad engineering versatility across languages, testing practices (TDD, CI/CD), and infrastructure tooling (Docker, Kubernetes)
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (roughly 7 months professionally)
No formal technical leadership role managing priorities, deadlines, or cross-team alignment
Career focus is web/product engineering, not cloud compute platforms or hardware/storage architecture
